notes: Someone who gives testimony about what they have seen or heard. In Acts it is the disciples' job: "You will be witnesses to me" (1:8). The word later took on the sense of one who dies for the testimony, from which "martyr" comes.

range.note: One who dies for the testimony.

elsewhere.note: On the evidence of two or three witnesses.
You are witnesses of these things.
You made the good confession in the presence of many witnesses.
Jesus Christ the faithful witness.

elsewhere.note: You know neither the Scriptures nor the power of God.

Continue steadfastly in prayer.

Persons from every tribe and language.

They gave me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship.
Your partnership in the gospel.
Our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son.

elsewhere.note: The founder of their salvation.
The founder and perfecter of our faith.

If anyone among you wanders from the truth and someone brings him back.

elsewhere.note: Baptizing them in the name of the Father.

elsewhere.note: He said this plainly.
No one who wants to be known openly acts in secret.
That I may boldly make known the mystery of the gospel.

elsewhere.note: He has raised up a horn of salvation for us.
The power of God for salvation.
The gospel of your salvation.

elsewhere.note: Be submissive to rulers and authorities, to be obedient.
